subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should package changelog preview generation allow platform moderators and administrators to read an existing package’s prior release content, alongside direct owners and authorized publisher-organization members?
rationale: The implementation consistently enforces the proposed roles before storage access, but source correctness cannot determine whether elevated platform roles are intended to have this package-content access outside a moderation operation.

options.title: Approve the tested boundary
options.body: Keep owner, publisher-organization, moderator, and administrator access after resolving conflicts and retaining the pre-storage authorization tests.

options.title: Limit access to publishers
options.body: Remove moderator and administrator bypasses unless the caller also has package-owner or publisher-organization authority, then update the focused tests.

recommendation.title: Approve the tested boundary
recommendation.body: Keep owner, publisher-organization, moderator, and administrator access after resolving conflicts and retaining the pre-storage authorization tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available current-main owner for the affected plugin publishing flow, though backend security ownership remains less certain.
